ValidationRule.description: Requires Deal Value for stages beyond Qualification
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Deal_Stage__c, "Proposal"), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Stage__c, "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Stage__c, "Closed Won") ), ISBLANK(Deal_Value__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Value is required for stages beyond Qualification
